worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.summary: Scoop up near-freezing water and douse the target: it saps their power (Attack falls) and soaks them, leaving a wet patch where it lands. An already-soaked target is chilled harder, taking more damage and losing an extra Attack stage.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.use.1: Soak the target so later water and ice moves can exploit the wet state
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.descript: Deals about %1$s special damage on hit.

Lowers Attack by %1$s stages and soaks the target for %2$s, reducing movement speed by 10%%. An already wet target takes a stronger splash and an extra Attack drop when first chilled. Repeated Chilling Water refreshes the chill without stacking the reduction; Attack recovers when it expires or is cleansed.
Range %1$s blocks, glob speed %2$s blocks/tick, trace radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.growth.0: From level %1$s the douse rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.growth.1: From level %1$s the douse rises to %2$s power and the soak lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.preferen: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it weaken from further away.
